result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. Two visual defects stand out: the top-right header button is an empty grey circle with only a red notification dot, and the favorite (heart) button on the first Popular card has an almost invisible background, unlike the matching button on the card below.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right header, next to the delivery address, is an empty light-grey circle with only a red notification dot. The icon or avatar that should be inside it is missing, so users cannot tell what the control does.
issues.suggestion: Make sure the profile avatar or notification icon loads and renders inside the circle. Add a default placeholder icon (such as a user silhouette or bell) for when the image fails to load or the user has no avatar.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a background that nearly blends into the dark photo. The same button on the pizza card below has a clearly visible dark circle. This makes the two buttons inconsistent and the first one harder to see.
issues.suggestion: Give all favorite buttons the same semi-transparent backdrop and opacity so they stay visible and consistent on any image.
